1	-- test_init.lua — structural and behavioral tests for hammerspoon/init.lua
2	--
3	-- Run via tests/test_init.sh (which drives it through the Hammerspoon `hs` CLI,
4	-- since there is no standalone Lua interpreter in this stack).
5	--
6	-- These tests guard the bug classes that have actually bitten this file:
7	--   * a top-level local referenced by an earlier-defined function, which silently
8	--     compiles to a nil global instead of capturing the local
9	--   * the Lua 200-local-per-function ceiling
10	--   * unguarded hs.sound.getByFile(...):play(), which throws and aborts its callback
11	--   * chunk filenames sorted as strings, which reorders audio past chunk 999
12	--   * a modifier-combo trigger matched with `flags & mask > 0`, which fires on half
13	--     the combo -- every Ctrl-C would start a recording
14	--   * removed subsystems (meeting mode, LLM refine, silence auto-stop, ...) creeping back
15	--
16	-- Config (set as globals by the runner; `hs` does not inherit the caller's environment):
17	--   LW_TARGET  path to the init.lua under test (default: repo copy)
18	--   LW_OUT     path to write results to (default: /tmp/lw_test_init.txt)
19	
20	local HOME   = os.getenv("HOME")
21	local TARGET = _G.LW_TARGET or (HOME .. "/Documents/GitHub/local-whisper/hammerspoon/init.lua")
22	local OUT    = _G.LW_OUT or "/tmp/lw_test_init.txt"
23	
24	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
25	-- Harness
26	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
27	
28	local results = {}
29	
30	local function record(name, passed, detail)
31	    results[#results + 1] = {
32	        name   = name,
33	        passed = passed and true or false,
34	        detail = detail or "",
35	    }
36	end
37	
38	local function check(name, passed, detail)
39	    record(name, passed, passed and "" or (detail or ""))
40	end

42	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
43	-- Source loading + lexical helpers
44	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
45	
46	local function readSource(path)
47	    local f = io.open(path, "r")
48	    if not f then return nil end
49	    local src = f:read("*a")
50	    f:close()
51	    return src
52	end
53	
54	local src = readSource(TARGET)
55	if not src then
56	    record("source readable", false, "cannot open " .. TARGET)
57	    local f = io.open(OUT, "w")
58	    f:write("FAIL\tsource readable\tcannot open " .. TARGET .. "\n")
59	    f:close()
60	    return
61	end
62	
63	local lines = {}
64	for line in (src .. "\n"):gmatch("([^\n]*)\n") do
65	    lines[#lines + 1] = line
66	end
67	
68	-- Blank out string literals and comments so scans don't match inside them.
69	local function strip(line)
70	    line = line:gsub('"[^"]*"', '""')
71	    line = line:gsub("'[^']*'", "''")
72	    line = line:gsub("%-%-.*$", "")
73	    return line
74	end
75	
76	local stripped = {}
77	for i, l in ipairs(lines) do stripped[i] = strip(l) end
78	
79	-- Word-boundary match for an identifier.
80	local function usesName(line, name)
81	    return line:find("%f[%w_]" .. name .. "%f[^%w_]") ~= nil
82	end
83	
84	-- Blank out identifier occurrences that are not variable *reads*, so the
85	-- use-before-declaration scan doesn't fire on them:
86	--   * field access / method call  -- obj.name, obj:name
87	--   * assignment targets and table-constructor keys -- name = ..., { name = ... }
88	-- A read of `name` on the right-hand side survives, which is what the scan wants.
89	local function readsOnly(s)
90	    s = s:gsub("%.%s*[%w_]+", " ")
91	    s = s:gsub(":%s*[%w_]+", " ")
92	    s = s:gsub("[%w_]+%s*=[^=]", " ")
93	    return s
94	end
95	
96	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
97	-- Sandbox helpers (behavioral tests)
98	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
99	-- Functions are lifted out of the source under test and executed against stubbed
100	-- globals, so the tests exercise the real implementation rather than a copy that
101	-- drifts. Every name the lifted function closes over in init.lua resolves to the
102	-- sandbox _ENV here, which is what makes the stubs and the after-the-fact state
103	-- assertions work.
104	
105	local function baseEnv()
106	    return {
107	        math = math, string = string, table = table, os = os,
108	        tostring = tostring, tonumber = tonumber, type = type,
109	        ipairs = ipairs, pairs = pairs, select = select,
110	    }
111	end
112	
113	local function loadIn(chunk, env, name)
114	    return load(chunk, name or "sandbox", "t", env)
115	end
116	
117	-- Source text of a top-level `local function NAME(...) ... end`, located by its
118	-- declaration and terminated by the matching column-0 `end`.
119	local function extractFunction(name)
120	    local startLine
121	    for i, s in ipairs(stripped) do
122	        if s:match("^local%s+function%s+" .. name .. "%s*%(") then startLine = i break end
123	    end
124	    if not startLine then return nil end
125	    for i = startLine + 1, #lines do
126	        if stripped[i]:match("^end%s*$") then
127	            return table.concat({ table.unpack(lines, startLine, i) }, "\n")
128	        end
129	    end
130	    return nil
131	end
132	
133	-- Load a lifted `local function` and return it, bound to `env`.
134	local function liftFunction(name, env)
135	    local fnSrc = extractFunction(name)
136	    if not fnSrc then return nil, "could not locate local function " .. name .. "()" end
137	    local factory, err = loadIn(fnSrc .. "\nreturn " .. name, env, name)
138	    if not factory then return nil, tostring(err) end
139	    return factory()
140	end

150	-- 2. Lua 200-local-per-function ceiling (AGENTS.md hard limit)
151	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
152	
153	local topLevelLocals = 0
154	for _, s in ipairs(stripped) do
155	    if s:match("^local%s") then topLevelLocals = topLevelLocals + 1 end
156	end
157	check("locals: top-level count within Lua's 200 ceiling",
158	      topLevelLocals <= 200,
159	      "found " .. topLevelLocals .. " top-level locals (limit 200)")

161	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
162	-- 3. No top-level local referenced before it is declared
163	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
164	-- A `local` is only in scope after its declaration. A function defined earlier that
165	-- references the name does NOT capture it -- the reference compiles to a global read
166	-- that is nil at runtime, with no load-time error. This produced three live bugs in
167	-- the overlay code (X button, unpin, menu-bar pinning).
168	
169	-- Collect top-level declarations: name -> first declaring line.
170	local decls = {}
171	for i, s in ipairs(stripped) do
172	    local fname = s:match("^local%s+function%s+([%w_]+)")
173	    if fname then
174	        decls[fname] = decls[fname] or i
175	    else
176	        local names = s:match("^local%s+([%w_%s,]-)%s*=") or s:match("^local%s+([%w_%s,]+)%s*$")
177	        if names then
178	            for n in names:gmatch("[%w_]+") do
179	                if n ~= "function" then decls[n] = decls[n] or i end
180	            end
181	        end
182	    end
183	end
